title: Pyon Pyon Kyaruru no Mahjong Biyori
native_title: ぴょんぴょんキャルルのまあじゃん日和
overview: Pyon Pyon Kyaruru no Mahjong Hiyori is a family-friendly 1-on-1 style mahjong game featuring a cast of cutesy cartoon characters. Gameplay is a straightforward translation of Japanese-style reach mahjong with no notable additional features, and includes both a story mode with five playable (plus one unlockable) characters and a free match mode, along with a gallery featuring unlockable artwork of the characters.
